_comment: AAASM-5791 product-smoke scenario pack. An LLM QA agent (or a human) can
execute this pack via `cargo test -p aa-integration-tests --test
sensitive_data_product_smoke` without reading aa-security/aa-gateway
source: the 'support' and 'expect' fields below are the full contract.
Payloads are NOT duplicated here where a conformance vector already
covers the case — 'vector_ref' points at the existing
conformance/vectors/{credential_detection,zh_tw_detection}/*.json file
the runner loads the input_text from. Only classes with no existing
vector (the intentionally-unsupported semantic classes, and the two
policy-defined-pattern cases) carry an inline 'payload'.
'support' values:
supported        - v1 ships a detector for this; a finding is expected.
negative_control  - benign content; NO finding is expected, and the
content must remain usable (redacted_payload is None).
unsupported       - v1 has no detector for this class today (semantic
PII, deferred to provider work post-v1 per ADR 0032
D-1). Expected result is EXPECTED_UNSUPPORTED: no
finding, decision stays Allow, nothing is redacted.
This is a claim about today's product, not a defect.
Expected values are NOT derived from aa-security's own tables: they were
written by reading the conformance vectors' committed expected_findings
(authored independently of this pack) and, for the unsupported class,
by grepping aa-security/src for the class name and finding no detector.

scenarios.persona: agent embedding a leaked API key in a tool call

agent embedding a Slack bot token in a tool call
agent embedding a database connection string with inline credentials

agent including a customer email address in a tool call
agent including a US Social Security Number in a tool call
agent including an unlabelled high-entropy token in a tool call
operator-defined internal token pattern
agent recording a Taiwan National ID in a tool call
agent recording a new-format Alien Resident Certificate number
agent recording a Taiwan business/tax identifier
agent recording a Taiwan mobile phone number
agent recording a Taiwan mobile phone number in +886 international form
agent writing an ordinary English status update
agent writing an ordinary Traditional Chinese status update
agent writing a mixed zh-TW/English status update

scenarios.notes: No passport detector exists in aa-security/src (grep returns zero matches). Deferred semantic PII per ADR 0032 D-1.
